Crime & Law · India

Two clerks arrested for accepting bribes in separate incidents

Two clerks were arrested for allegedly accepting bribes in separate incidents across India. In Bokaro Thermal, two clerks were apprehended by the CBI while accepting ₹18,000 in bribes at the Govindpur project. Separately, in Faridabad, a clerk was arrested for demanding ₹45,000 and accepting ₹20,000 to provide financial records of an RWA. In Bhiwani, a field kanungo was arrested for accepting ₹10,000 to upload a copy report.
